description: The fixed set of effect operations. Per field, effects apply in `order` (lower first; atLeast and atMost share a stage). `order` 0 is no field stage: grant comes with the field's own value, and the tag, choice, step and action ops have their own timing (effects.md).

items.description: Replace the value from the field's own formula. Several active set effects on one field compete; the engine reports them and the recommended one. On a roll, it replaces the parts its target's `parts` tags name.
Add a number. On a roll, adds a roll item (a flat number, or dice such as 1d4). On an incoming change, adds to its amount.
Multiply by a number (0.5 halves, 2 doubles), then round by the game's rounding. Applied after add, matching resistance applied to the total.
Raise the value to at least this number. On a roll, raise its total once the dice are rolled; the step's result and log list the bound in `bounds`.
Lower the value to at most this number. On a roll, lower its total once the dice are rolled, after any atLeast.
Add a member to a set field: a proficiency, a tag, an action, or every match of a query. On a set of fields, to each `set` field it matches.
Change how a roll is made: one of the roll modifier kinds (advantage, extra dice multiplier, reroll, …).

Add tags to a roll's parts: the items of the parts its target's `parts` tags name gain the value's tags (entries may be formulas), after replaced parts and before anything else reads the roll (Dragon Breath's damage typed by the element chosen on each use).

Add an option to an action's choice steps with a matching tag: `{ id, changes?, to?, flags? }`, offered after the step's own options while the effect's `when` holds, with ID `<content id>#<id>` (`<pack>:rules#<id>` for the rules' effects).

Add changes to an action's changes steps with a matching tag, or set its flags there: `{ changes?, to?, flags?, order? }`, each time the step runs while the effect's `when` holds. `flags` are set before the step's own changes; `changes` are proposed after them, or before with `order: before`.

Run a rules action at an action's changes steps with a matching tag: `{ id, use, params?, participants?, each?, as?, changes?, to? }`, each time the step runs while the effect's `when` holds, after the step's changes, per participant with `each`; `as: participant` hands it off. Its `changes` follow, seeing the run's outcome as `run`.

Add parameters to listed actions with a matching tag: `{ <name>: <declaration> }`, each optional, defaulted or derived (`formula`), after the action's own on the run the app starts while the effect's `when` holds. Their `min` and `max` may read the action's `params`. An entry with only `min` and/or `max`, naming a parameter the run already has, adds bounds to it instead. A name an action the literal tags reach declares, or another effect's other declaration of it (not between `from: self` effects of different content items that no item holding both has an action both reach), is a load error; through computed tags, the action's own and then the first effect's win.
